description: Use when you need the current DNS records of a domain or hostname: resolves the requested record types live over DNS-over-HTTPS (Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 with Google fallback) and returns every answer with TTL, plus the response code (NOERROR/NXDOMAIN) and whether DNSSEC validated. Up to 8 types per call. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.001 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.

name.description: Domain or hostname, e.g. example.com or www.example.com.

type.description: Comma-separated record types (max 8). Supported: A, NS, CNAME, SOA, PTR, MX, TXT, AAAA, SRV, DS, DNSKEY, HTTPS, SVCB, CAA.

name: dns
title: ScrapeMole Domains: DNS, WHOIS/RDAP, domain availability, email security, SSL certificates and subdomains for AI agents: DNS lookup
